name: r9nano
description: AMD Radeon R9 Nano (Fiji XT, GCN 3, gfx803) at its 1000 MHz engine clock: one Vortex core per CU; the CU is Polaris's (rx580).

sources.CU (all core knobs): Inherited from rx580: GCN 3 (Fiji) and GCN 4 (Polaris) share the CU: 4 SIMD16 units running wave64, 40 waves, 16 KB vector L1, 64 KB LDS, FP64 at 1/16
sources.NUM_CORES: 64 CUs, 4096 stream processors (AMD Radeon R9 Nano specifications); the configuration MGPUSim's r9nano timing model builds (sarchlab/mgpusim amd/samples/runner/timingconfig/r9nano)
sources.L2_SIZE, L2_NUM_WAYS, L2_NUM_BANKS: 2 MB L2 (Fiji; MGPUSim's r9nano l2CacheSize), 16 ways, 16 channels
sources.PLATFORM_MEMORY_TYPE, PLATFORM_MEMORY_NU: 4 first-generation HBM stacks x 8 128-bit channels = 32 channels at 1 Gbps: 32 x 16 B x 1000 MT/s = 512 GB/s, modelled with the HBM2 array timing (Ramulator has no HBM1)
sources.PLATFORM_CLOCK_RATE: 1000 MHz engine clock (R9 Nano specifications; MGPUSim's r9nano freq)
sources.reference: fp32_lanes is the vendor FP32 core count (FP32 FMA lanes per chip, clock-free); dram_bandwidth_gbs the vendor peak. Checked by ci/profile_check.py. MGPUSim validates its r9nano model against this card (Sun et al., MGPUSim, ISCA 2019); NaviSim's pointer chase on this card puts the L1 near 190 cycles (Bao et al., NaviSim, PACT 2022, Figure 1), read off a chart, so the chase metrics are unchecked
